question.trigger_rationale: The auto-exit exploration reported true from ApplyConfChange and false from Status for the same joint configuration. grounding.derivation: Config.Clone explicitly returns a copy of Config sharing no memory. AutoLeave is a semantic Config field documenting automatic versus manual joint exit. getStatus assigns the clone as its Config; the field must equal the installed policy absent intervening mutation.
grounding.applicability: Both implicit true and explicit false modes are independently established by actual committed configuration application; no simulated AutoLeave value is injected.
